title: Jacob Eapen
intro:
Report an officeholder change
Jacob Eapen is an at-large member of the Washington Township Health Care District Board of Directors in California.
Eapen won re-election for an at-large seat of the Washington Township Health Care District Board of Directors in California outright without appearing on the ballot. If the election had not been canceled, the general election would have been held on November 3, 2026.
